mapper.select:
select p.id productId, p.name,
pi.url mainImage,
min(ps.price) minPrice
from product.product p
left join product.product_sku ps on p.id = ps.product_id
left join product.product_image pi on p.id = pi.product_id and pi.type = 1
where p.status = 1
and p.category_id = #{categoryId}
group by p.id, p.name, pi.url, p.created_time
order by min(ps.price)
order by min(ps.price) desc
order by p.created_time desc
limit #{offset}, #{size}

select count(*) from product.product where status = 1
and p.category_id = #{categoryId}
